method: Chromium CDP: cold contexts, real font requests, gzip text transport matching public Pages, disabled HTTP cache and worker, 4x CPU, 150ms latency, 1.6Mbps download/750Kbps upload. Finite real click/key tasks; Event Timing p98 candidate, not field INP.
limitations: One local host, not physical Android/iOS
Separate baseline/candidate reports; no production-origin field comparison
External request failures are reported, not stubbed or treated as successful font loads

Synthetic V2 celebration fixture, reduced motion to match the baseline; no religious date approval or physical-device animation certification. Single-run values are indicative, not a regression/CWV certificate.
